link_notes: No code repo and no full text in the digest; judgements rest on the abstract alone.

open_release.rationale: Abstract frames simulated EHR data as a way to resolve the tension between data sharing and patient privacy and tests membership and attribute inference attacks.

quotes.text: Simulating electronic health record data offers an opportunity to resolve the tension between data sharing and patient privacy.
The privacy risks in synthetic data, with respect to the membership and attribute inference were negligible.

pipeline_testing.rationale: Abstract says nothing about testing or software pipelines and no full text or README is available.

ml_augmentation.rationale: Abstract evaluates diagnosis prediction models trained on real versus synthetic temporal data and reports the AUROC difference.

quotes.text: diagnosis prediction models based on real versus synthetic temporal data exhibited an average relative difference in area under the ROC curve of 1.6%

statistical_replication.rationale: Abstract defines three utility measures for preserved feature correlations and temporal patterns and reports similarity to real sequences.

quotes.text: We designed 3 utility measures to characterize the extent to which the framework maintains feature correlations and temporal patterns in clinical events.

causal_inference.rationale: Abstract describes temporal patterns, not causal structure, and no full text is available to settle it.

education.rationale: No teaching framing in the abstract and no README or full text to check.

benchmarking.rationale: Abstract does not say whether SynTEG is used as a baseline or benchmark, and no full text is available.

imbalance_correction.rationale: Abstract has no class-imbalance framing and no full text is available to check.
